data.title: Speeding fine, €98.50 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Berlin police fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 12 November 2025. Total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving register. The notice was delivered on 11 December 2025.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. The fine is €70 plus €25 fee and €3.50 costs, and you get 1 point. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office within two weeks of delivery; the app shows the deadline. If you don't object, the notice becomes final and the total is due two weeks after that. In court, the judge isn't bound by the fine amount. Consider legal advice before objecting.
